title: Creature Ecology, Behavior, Social Structure, Territory & Tactics Authoring
objective: Add creature ecology, behavior, social-structure, territory and tactics proposal authoring over authoritative Species/Form, Environment, Creature and encounter/combat owner-domain records without creating duplicate ecology, world-state or tactical truth ledgers.

scope.purpose: Provide bounded creature ecology/behavior/social/territory/tactics authoring and projections while retaining owner-domain truth and unresolved-safe behavior.
scope.completion_gate: Creature ecology, behavior, social structure, territory and tactics can be authored as explicit proposals/projections without duplicating authoritative Species/Form, Environment, Creature, Encounter or Combat truth.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.4 and MNCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json were reconsulted after exact-tree MNCS-10 publication.
The DAG contains no MNCS-10-triggered rotation or newly eligible unfinished interstitial that overrides MNCS strict order; MNCS-12 is the next unfinished surviving tranche.
Species/Form, Creature, Environment, Encounter and Combat owner domains retain canonical biology, habitat/world-state and tactical truth; MNCS-12 composes proposals/projections only.
Missing or unresolved ecology, social, territory or tactics facts must remain unresolved rather than being invented.

MNCS-12 is governed-started on branch work/mncs-12-creature-ecology-behavior-territory-tactics from fresh application main cff611265c9dca1d9b670ba41db68f2e51b451b4; implementation authority is limited to this bounded tranche.
The independent ui-implementation lane remains UISR-08 in_progress and the player-species lane remains MVPS-01 selected_not_started; both are preserved unchanged.
next_action: Establish causal RED for creature ecology, behavior, social structure, territory and tactics proposal/projection authoring, owner-reference preservation, unresolved-safe ecological/tactical facts, no duplicate ecology/world-state/tactical ledgers and local-first operation; then implement only bounded MNCS-12 behavior through validation, serialized publication and closeout.
